controlledBeta.scope.title: What's included in controlled beta
controlledBeta.scope.item1: All capabilities operate in Mode D (advisory) — outputs are decision-support, not regulator-recognised decisions.
controlledBeta.scope.item2: No billable events are generated. No payment is collected.
controlledBeta.scope.item3: Your organisation's data is stored in Saudi Arabia (me-central2 / Dammam) per PDPL.
controlledBeta.scope.item4: Feedback is collected in-app and through a dedicated channel.

settings.billing.unavailableTitle: Billing is unavailable in the controlled beta
settings.billing.unavailableBody: Capabilities operate in Mode D (advisory) during the controlled-beta window. No billable events are generated, no payment method is collected, and no subscription is active. Billing surfaces will be available after activation.
employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: View team records and ERI signals. Add and edit are read-only during the controlled-beta window.
saudisation.title: Saudisation
saudisation.subtitle: Nitaqat zone, Saudisation rate, and advisor recommendations.
saudisation.advisorSubtitle: Advisory-only recommendations. Each output carries its own attribution, confidence band, reasoning, and source citation. Human approval is required before any regulated action.
saudisation.guardrailsNote: Approve or reject the advisor's recommendation manually. WorkCaptain never auto-applies regulated actions, modifies policy state, or activates deferred capabilities.
saudisation.guardrail3: No activation of deferred capabilities via this surface.
payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.subtitle: WPS readiness, payroll status, and pack history.
payroll.readOnlyBody: Payroll execution is partner-mediated via licensed WPS providers. No payment is initiated from this surface.
payroll.wpsSubtitle: Latest validated pack for your organisation's wage protection submission.
compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.subtitle: GOSI, Qiwa, and Mudad filing calendar plus reminders.
compliance.calendarSubtitle: Upcoming and recent compliance filings. Items marked with a gear icon are auto-derived reminders — the source-of-truth lives in the upstream authority's portal.
trust.title: Trust
trust.subtitle: Audit trail, consent, data export, and residency.
trust.audit.title: Audit trail
trust.audit.subtitle: Chronological record of agent recommendations, your approval decisions, and evidence-pack access events.
trust.audit.dataChangesNote: Tenant data-change events (VERITAS event log) are operator-surface scope and will be exposed in a separate cohort-admin viewer after the controlled-beta window. Audit-trail rows above cover agent actions, human approvals, and evidence-pack access.
trust.consent.title: Consent ledger
trust.consent.subtitle: Your active PDPL processing consents and the data-subject requests you've submitted.
trust.consent.revokeComingSoon: Individual-consent revoke ships after the controlled beta. For now, use a PDPL data-subject request below (Erasure or Restriction).
trust.consent.dsrSubtitle: Submit a PDPL request to access, rectify, erase, port, restrict, or object to the processing of your data. Our DPO responds within 30 days. SLA alerts trigger at day 25.
trust.consent.dsr.ACCESS: Access — request a copy of your data
trust.consent.dsr.ERASURE: Erasure — delete your data (subject to retention obligations)
trust.consent.dsr.PORTABILITY: Portability — receive your data in a portable format
trust.consent.dsr.RESTRICTION: Restriction — restrict processing while a dispute is resolved
trust.consent.dsrDescPlaceholder: What data is in scope, and what outcome do you need?
trust.consent.dsrSubmitted: Request submitted. Our DPO will respond within 30 days.
trust.export.title: Data export
trust.export.subtitle: Download signed evidence packs with hash-integrity verification. 60-second SLA per pack.
trust.export.queueNote: Exports queue while in transit. The chip in the bottom corner tracks each export through queued → succeeded states.
trust.residency.title: Data residency
trust.residency.subtitle: Where your data lives, and what we do (and do not) claim about it.
trust.residency.regionStatement: Your data is stored in Saudi Arabia — Google Cloud me-central2 (Dammam) region.
trust.residency.detail: Cloud Blueprint v2.1 binds in-Kingdom region-lock per Cloud Computing Regulatory Framework guidance. Disaster-recovery within KSA where applicable; cross-border transfer is governed by PDPL Article 29 and SDAIA classification.
trust.residency.limit1: We do not claim NCA ECC certification. We design with NCA-ECC awareness; certification is not held.
trust.residency.limit2: We do not claim SAMA licensing. WorkCaptain is workforce decision-support, not a regulated financial-services platform.
trust.residency.limit3: We do not claim ISO 27001, SOC 2, or other third-party certifications during the controlled-beta window. They are not in scope yet.
